limitations: Zero confirmed ceased or conference-only records is a finding within this bounded audit, not proof that all 119 are active journals. Only selected official pages were inspected.

Continued By blank is not evidence of active submission or publication.

verified_examples.title: Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence
verified_examples.doaj_subjects: Science: Mathematics: Instruments and machines: Electronic computers. Computer science
verified_examples.observation: Official ScienceDirect search result identifies volume 10 (June 2026), article 100598, DOI 10.1016/j.caeai.2026.100598; its subject is reporting research on artificial intelligence in education.
limitations: Journal homepage and direct article fetch returned errors. This is indexed official publisher metadata, not a successfully fetched full page. No citation metrics inferred.

verified_examples.title: Advances in Physiology Education
verified_examples.observation: Official 2026 editorial by Bryan Mackenzie describes education scholarship for physiology and related biomedical teaching; official journal search results list 2026 articles.
limitations: Direct fetch of editorial returned HTTP 403; no access restriction was bypassed.

verified_examples.title: RUDN Journal of Informatization in Education
verified_examples.doaj_subjects: Technology: Technology (General): Industrial engineering. Management engineering: Information technology
verified_examples.observation: Official page displays ISSNs 2312-8631/2312-864X, education-process informatization scope, and current issue 23(3), 2026 including AI in education.

verified_examples.title: International Journal of Chinese Language Teaching
verified_examples.doaj_subjects: Language and Literature: Languages and literature of Eastern Asia, Africa, Oceania: Chinese language and literature
verified_examples.observation: Official page displays ISSN 2708-9517, Chinese language teaching research scope, English/Chinese submissions, and 2026 issue archive links.

verified_examples.title: Future of Medical Education Journal
verified_examples.observation: Official page observed current issue 16(3), Summer 2026; print ISSN 2251-8347 and online ISSN 2251-8355; contents include medical curriculum and teaching.
limitations: Initial page fetch succeeded; later re-fetch timed out. Source evidence describes the observed page, not a promise of current submissions.

verified_examples.title: Journal of Environmental and Science Education
verified_examples.doaj_subjects: Geography. Anthropology. Recreation: Environmental sciences | Technology: Environmental technology. Sanitary engineering
verified_examples.observation: Official scope explicitly includes science curriculum, instruction, and science-teacher preparation. Issue 6(1) was published on 2026-04-23; both ISSNs are shown.

verified_examples.title: Physics Education Research Journal
verified_examples.observation: Official page confirms physics/physics-education scope, both ISSNs, and current issue 7(2), published 2025-12-11.
limitations: No 2026 issue was visible; publication in 2026 or current acceptance of submissions is not confirmed.

verified_examples.title: Research and Humanities in Medical Education
verified_examples.doaj_subjects: Medicine: Medicine (General): Medical philosophy. Medical ethics
verified_examples.observation: Official page displays current volume 13 (2026), published 2026-01-01, including a narrative on competency-based medical education.
limitations: Medical humanities content includes narratives and poetry; inclusion does not mean every article is empirical education research.

verified_examples.title: International Journal of First Aid Education
verified_examples.doaj_subjects: Medicine: Internal medicine: Medical emergencies. Critical care. Intensive care. First aid
verified_examples.observation: Official issue archive search result displays volume 9(1), 2026, eight items and ISSN 2514-7153.
limitations: Direct access subsequently returned a bot-protection page; no bypass attempted. The publication observation is based on indexed official-domain content.

verified_examples.title: Graduate Medical Education Research Journal
verified_examples.observation: Official UNMC page shows volume 8(1), 2026, original research, reviews and brief reports including AI-based simulated patient encounters; separate conference-proceedings section is also present.
limitations: Mixed content includes clinical research and conference abstracts. This is not a conference-only series; title-derived education scope is broader than a pure educational-research journal.
